historical_simplification.repository_ranking_contract: sha256(sniffbench-non-blind-history-v1\0 || ranking_seed || \0 || canonical_repository_identity), ascending digest then identity
historical_simplification.commit_ranking_contract: sha256(sniffbench-non-blind-commit-v1\0 || ranking_seed || \0 || canonical_repository_identity || \0 || full_commit_sha), ascending digest then commit SHA
commit_requirements: exactly one parent and not a merge
both parent and commit are immutable full Git revisions
changes at least one supported production source file
does not consist only of generated, vendored, test, fixture, example, documentation, lock, or formatting changes

before and after revisions both pass the same default CI test command declared by the repository at the candidate commit; inability to reproduce that command is a typed exclusion, never permission to choose a smaller test subset
the selected source delta removes or consolidates behavior while preserving the tested public contract
selection uses only commit metadata and deterministic source/test facts, never Sniff output or a slop label

required_artifacts: checkpoint tests and raw pass/fail results
required_sources.availability_as_of_policy: harness and problems available; official v0.3 release has no run assets; linked Zenodo records 18405900 and 19257129 contain PDFs only
no official artifact repository or downloadable trajectory dataset was located

research_trajectories.selection_rule: Use every licensed exact trajectory pair supplied by the required sources up to 20 pairs per source, ranked by sha256(source_id || NUL || upstream_record_id). Do not substitute reference solutions, paper excerpts, aggregate metrics, third-party recreations, or newly generated Sniff output.
research_trajectories.failure_rule: The ResearchTrajectory partition remains incomplete until at least one exact qualifying pair from each required source is sealed. Missing artifacts are a failed prerequisite, not permission to invent or approximate data.

intentional_boundaries.candidate_ranking_contract: sha256(sniffbench-intentional-boundary-v1\0 || ranking_seed || \0 || immutable_repository_revision || \0 || repository_path || \0 || exact_symbol_identity), ascending digest then identity
requirements: candidate source is outside the blind OSS seal
the exact public/framework/test contract is captured as a hash-bound behavioral artifact before labeling
selection is based on observable role and contract evidence, not path/name alone and never Sniff output
independent adjudication must confirm Clean and intentional_boundary before the case can satisfy this partition
a failed candidate closes its precommitted slot rather than allowing a hand-picked replacement
